name: frequency band
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 指定上下限之间的频率范围。

complete_examples.text: With the development of cumulative deformation of subgrade, the vibrations of the car body are excited in the frequency band of 0∼100 Hz.

For example, the time-frequency characteristic of car body vertical accelerations deteriorates in the frequency range of 0∼100 Hz, and the energy density in the excited frequency band is obviously greater.
